payload.evidence: Bound Windows worker reproduced 401 when awaiting the same native task after a legitimate account session reconnect. payload.diagnosis: The terminal observer revalidates all middleware-authenticated tokens against the access-key store. Accounts authenticate their session through the session store. This misclassification denies a still-authorized observer.
